description: Intentionally vulnerable Express.js app integrating with LLM APIs and exposing jokes via a conversational AI assistant. Demonstrates common LLM-driven web integration security issues, based on Liran Tal's llm-ai-security repo.

vulnerabilities.description: Unsanitized input from data from a remote resource flows into innerHTML in the chat UI, where it is used to dynamically construct the HTML page on the client side. This may result in a DOM Based Cross-Site Scripting attack (DOMXSS).
Disable X-Powered-By header for your Express app (consider using Helmet middleware), because it exposes information about the used framework to potential attackers.
Unsanitized input from an LLM flows into res.send(), where it is used to render an HTML page returned to the user. This may result in a Cross-Site Scripting attack (XSS).
